entry.title: Ondes 0.5.0
entry.summary: Ondes 0.5.0: an Ondes Martenot-style instrument for MPC OS standalone devices (Gen1, 32-bit ARM), as a native VST2 with its own screen skin. **What's in it** - The eight drawer timbres, combinable: O Sine, 8 Octave, C Hollow, G Square, g Soft Square, N Nasal, S Breath, T All - Intensity key: velocity, aftertouch, mod wheel, expression pedal or breath; curve, dead zone, smoothing; Note + Intensity or Intensity Only - Keyboard and Ribbon modes (ribbon hold for the touch strip), hand vibrato, six t
